predecessors.name: Principality of Polotsk
predecessors.text: Drutsk, given to Rogvolod-Boris when Vseslav's Polotsk territory was divided among his sons

successors.name: Principality of Minsk
successors.text: Drutsk, 'entirely taken over by the Principality of Minsk' in the second half of the 13th century

ledger.x: 1101: Drutsk becomes a principality under Rogvolod-Boris when Polotsk is divided.
1116: Vladimir Monomakh's Kiev takes over Drutsk.
1140: Drutsk is again ruled by its own princes.
Second half of the 13th century: Minsk absorbs Drutsk.
The Principality of Drutsk ends in Minsk's.

wars.name: Kievan takeover of Drutsk (1116)
wars.outcome: The Principality of Drutsk was taken over by the Grand Principality of Kiev in 1116 and had princes of the Polotsk line again from 1140.

wars.name: Quarrel over Polotsk (1162)
wars.outcome: 'the princes of Vitebsk, Minsk and Drutsk began to quarrel over the control of Polotsk' in 1162; no territorial result on the page.

certainty.note: The pages give a position 'between the Vitebsk, Minsk and Mogilev regions' and no frontier line.
